analyst.summary: Alivus (formerly Glenmark Life Sciences, now Nirma Group-controlled) is a debt-free, high-return API/CDMO manufacturer with a genuinely clean USFDA record (all inspections classified VAI, none escalated) and clean promoter governance (no share pledge). FY26 revenue grew a modest 6.9% and Q4 showed some margin pressure from rising employee costs, partly offset by a lower tax rate. Management guides high-single-digit growth for FY27 stepping up to double-digit from FY28 as its CDMO and high-potency API pipeline scale, but that acceleration hasn't shown up in reported numbers yet and the stock's ~25x earnings multiple already leans on it happening. We rate it a Hold: good business, full price, execution-dependent upside.
